metadata.edition: Decree of 2011 (number, signing date and Gazette commencement blank in the copy; 1 January 2011 is a placeholder) · ss. 4 to 7 Fiji Medicinal Products Board, s. 6(f) recall, 6(h) monitoring, 6(k) clinical trials; no pharmacovigilance provision
